blogs.name: Superprof Nigeria Blog
blogs.verificationMethod: Superprof itself strongly confirmed real — an established tutoring platform active in 28 countries since 2013. Content directly matches the founder's description, citing the same real market-size figure (₦100bn+/$250-400M). Feed URL uses the standard WordPress pattern since no feed link was directly confirmed in search results — moderate confidence, worth a direct check before shipping.

notes: Matches the founder's own honest finding, reinforced by an independent broader search this round: no dedicated Nigeria/Africa 'business of tutoring or running a school' YouTube channel exists — individual videos on the topic circulate, but no ongoing channel. Owogram's tutorial-center guide (the founder's #3 blog candidate) was independently re-confirmed as real and on-topic, but its RSS feed could not be confirmed this round, so left out rather than guess. No free book candidate found, matching the founder's finding exactly.
